span.p:
Senior analyst, judgment bar
already cleared (Part 13)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 1-2:
Data Feasibility check on your own
telemetry; pick a detection idea
and a hunt hypothesis

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 3-6:
Build self-written detection;
track false-positive rate against
real background activity

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 3-6:
Run one documented hunt;
state hypothesis and abandonment
condition before touching data

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 1-10 (ongoing):
Shadow-coaching log — mentor
an L1, observe a QA calibration
session, log every attempt

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 7-8:
Write up the detection with its
full false-positive-rate history

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 7-8:
Write up the hunt: negative
finding or detection candidate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 9-10:
Self-score the coaching signal
from the log, not from memory

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weeks 11-12:
Self-scoring rubric (Sec. 5) —
which signal actually came
back strongest?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Part 3 fork: choose detection
engineer, threat hunter, or team
lead with real evidence in hand
